 		Company Secretariat<br>24 March 2011<p>Australian Securities Exchange<br>530 Collins Street<br>Melbourne Victoria 3000<br>AUSTRALIA<p><br>Appointment of Company Secretary<br>Resignation of Company Secretary<p>We advise that Libby Joyner was appointed as Deputy Secretary of BHP Billiton Limited on Thursday, 24 March 2011.<p>Ms Joyner will work in the Group Secretariat.  She will report to Jane McAloon, Group Company Secretary of BHP Billiton, and will be based in Melbourne.<p>Ms Joyner&#8217;s appointment co-incides with the resignation of Fiona Smith from the position of Deputy Secretary of BHP Billiton Limited on the same date.<p><p><br>Jane McAloon<br>Group Company Secretary<p>A member of the BHP Billiton Group, which is headquartered in Australia<br>Registered Office: <br>180 Lonsdale Street, Melbourne, Victoria 3000, Australia<br>ABN 49 004 028 077<br>
	</font>
</p>
